root_cause: Commercial sales techniques, psychology, public research evidence, copy generation, executor quality proof and revenue outcomes existed but were not consistently joined into one runtime decision lineage.
decision: Make sales play, psychology, semantic source relevance, human copy quality, channel execution and outcome/revenue learning one canonical Powerhouse path without creating a second CRM or action engine.
prevention: every outbound action receives an explicit sales play and psychology/CTA contract
machine taxonomy cannot be used as prospect-facing personalization
trigger outreach requires human-readable public evidence plus semantic source-to-trigger relevance
predicted objections cannot self-promote to observed objections
recruitment is not M&A evidence and supplier directories are not AI buying-trigger evidence
Gmail and SalesRobot fail closed unless the canonical composer quality proof passes
outcomes and revenue are measured by channel, sales play, psychology and CTA
live composer and persuasion optimizer must be repository-canonical
symptom: Most executed sales actions were legacy_unclassified for message strategy.
Public research evidence existed on research actions but was not consistently linked to outbound actions.
Generic or semantically mismatched messages could be technically executable.
failed_approaches: Treat sales/copy psychology as documentation-only guidance.
Allow machine trigger taxonomy to stand in for a human-readable reason to contact someone.
Score copy quality without requiring semantic relevance between source evidence and commercial problem.
